topic.service: Backyard shed / detached home office or studio

sources.title: https://sammamish.municipal.codes/SMC/16.20.200
sources.supports: SMC 16.20.200 work exempt from permit: IRC tool/storage sheds, playhouses, not vehicle storage, floor area <=200 sf, height <=12 ft from grade plane; exemptions do not apply in critical areas or standard shoreline setbacks; no authorization to violate code
